steps.text: What decides how fast a pendulum swings? Let's experiment with different pendulum lengths.
Pick a pendulum length, then tap “Start Experiment” to measure its time period.
Now try a longer one. Notice: the longer the pendulum, the longer each swing takes — a bigger time period.
Length is what changes the time period — a long pendulum swings slowly, a short one swings quickly. That's how pendulum clocks are tuned.

coach.mission: Find out how pendulum length changes the time period.
whenStuck: Pick a length, tap “Start Experiment”, and note the time period.
Then try a different length and compare.
whenWrong: A longer pendulum takes longer per swing (bigger time period); a shorter one is quicker.
Change the length to change the time period.
whenCorrect: Right — the longer pendulum has a longer time period.
Good — length controls how fast a pendulum swings.
coach.done: You've discovered that length sets a pendulum's time period. Try more lengths, or move on when you're ready.
